title: Could the LZ event be a nuclear excitation? Dark-matter-induced 129Xe(39.6 keV) and 131Xe(80.2 keV) transitions and where they land in S1-S2
question: Where do SD-DM-induced 129Xe*/131Xe* excitation hybrids (NR + prompt 39.6/80.2 keV ER at one vertex) fall in (S1c, log10 S2c) for E_NR = 10-320 keV, can any reproduce (540.1 phd, 9268 phd) or be a lower-energy NR plus a 39.6 keV IC electron, what is the excitation/elastic SD rate ratio at 1 TeV, and how many hybrids would LZ hold for a coupling giving one elastic 248 keV event?
headline_result: No hybrid can reproduce the event: the 39.6 keV (80.2 keV) ER alone carries 702 (1470) electrons vs 269 observed, every hybrid lies above the ROI ceiling log10 S2c = 4.15, and at S1c = 540 hybrids sit +15.8/+22.8 sigma above the NR median (S2c 3.6-5.9x observed; two-equation root at E_ER = -2.7 keV); at 1 TeV the excitation/elastic SD rate ratio is 0.36 R (f_kin 0.427/0.255) and a coupling giving one elastic O4 event in 200-270 keV predicts 1.9 (R/0.1) hybrids in 2.84 t yr, all outside the ROI, with 29.8 low-energy elastic companions
key_numbers: ER quanta 39.58 keV Nph 2243 Ne 702 (247 phd, 4.384); 80.19 keV 4497/1470 (495 phd, 4.705); S1-matched hybrids E_NR 157 keV -> 4.520 (+15.8 sigma, sigma 0.0313), E_NR 34 keV -> 4.740 (+22.8 sigma); S2-match needs Ne_NR -433/-1201; residual slope +0.022 dex/keV, root E_ER -2.7 keV; 248+39.6 -> (745, 4.539), 248+80.2 -> (992, 4.786); f_kin 0.427/0.255 (June 0.451/0.276); excitation/elastic 0.36 R; (c4 mv^2)^2 = 0.0211, sigma_n^SD equiv 1.17e-40 cm^2; hybrids 0.19/0.58/1.9/5.8/19 for R 0.01/0.03/0.1/0.3/1; N_lo 29.8; recalled SD limit 4e-41 cm^2 -> 0.22 (R/0.1)/t/yr; v_min(248) 341 -> 390/437 km/s; m_chi,min for excitation 11.9/26.9 GeV, for 248 keV + E* 80/90 GeV; gamma mfp 0.17/0.99 mm; ER photon fraction of hybrid S1 46%/92%; WimPyDD |<S_n>|_eff 0.247/0.198
model_or_mechanism: NR + prompt ER quanta addition with LZ-tuned NEST (Table S5 with p(E) break, Table S3); two-equation solve in (E_NR, E_ER); WimPyDD O4 (isoscalar unit and neutron-only) per-isotope spectra with inelastic-DM kinematics delta = E* times a recalled bracketed inelastic/elastic structure-factor ratio R; Baxter SHM annual mean and 16 June; analytic SD q->0 and O4/O1 normalisation checks
stance: neutral (tool, projection, or constraint) - excludes the nuclear-excitation hybrid origin; does not discriminate elastic NR from MSSI or other hypotheses
result_type: computed (loci, kinematics, rate ratios) / estimated (absolute hybrid counts via recalled R and SD limit)
confidence: high for the exclusion (rests on ER charge yields alone); low for absolute hybrid rates (recalled structure-factor ratio, recalled SD limit, x2 density-matrix normalisation)
